physicalNotes: Radius 0.47 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Cañas et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-3984 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...30C/abstract): 326,979 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
